setup.title: Who is travelling?
setup.explorerDesc: Ages 8–11: countries, capitals, big rivers, with hints on the map.
setup.geographerDesc: Ages 12–15: cities, landforms, regions and borders, with less help.
setup.privacy: No account, no real name. Everything stays on this device.

parents.title: Parents & teachers
parents.teach: Africa's 54 countries, their capitals, major cities, rivers, lakes, landforms and regions. Explorer level for ages 8–11, Geographer for ages 12–15. Items that are harder to remember come back through spaced repetition.
parents.data: On this device only: the avatar, the generated nickname, progress, scores and settings. No account, no real name, no email, no cookie, no ads, no purchases, no trackers. The game sends no game data to any server.
parents.resetText: Erases all progress and settings on this device. This cannot be undone.
parents.accuracy: The facts were drafted with AI and checked against public sources; they await human review and carry the "AI draft" status. Please report any error to whoever shared the game with you.
parents.borders: Borders are approximate. The game follows the 54 UN member states: Somaliland appears within Somalia, and Western Sahara is shown as a non-self-governing territory, with no state status. This choice is not a political position.
parents.sources: Maps: Natural Earth (public domain). Flags: flag-icons (MIT). Fonts: OFL licence.
parents.access: Full keyboard play, a dyslexia-friendly font, reduced animations, and a no-movement mode in the settings.
parents.legal: This page describes how the game works. It is not legal advice.
